title: The Velvet Counter: choose the homepage layout
question: Three homepage layouts in the Velvet Counter world. Approve one, combine them, or ask for changes. The build has to match the one you approve.

options.label: A · The counter, overhead
options.thesis: One full-screen counter photo with the promise set on the velvet: 'Tested in front of you. Weighed in front of you.'
options.viewport: A full-bleed overhead counter: tray, touchstone, scale and loupe; headline left; rate label bottom right.
options.risk: First screen only; the hero rests on one big photograph, so the image quality carries everything.

options.label: B · Sit at our counter (split + trays)
options.thesis: A split hero with three labelled velvet trays (Bridal, Daily wear, Silver), then a brass-framed rate card on velvet, then the old-gold Tested / Weighed / Valued row.
options.viewport: Text left on black, the counter with three named trays right; the full rate table directly below.
options.risk: The most orderly of the three and the least dramatic first screen. The 24K, 18K and silver figures are placeholders; the build uses live data.

options.label: C · Know your gold (touchstone hero + tray rail)
options.thesis: A centred 'Know your gold.' over the touchstone streak, then 'On the counter today' as a swipeable rail of velvet trays, then the shop front with the visit block.
options.viewport: Touchstone left and bangle right, headline centred over them, WhatsApp and See today's rate as the buttons.
options.risk: The AI added a cart icon, cursors and a fake shop front. None ship: no cart, and the real shop-front photo replaces the fake one.
